title: Mass Concluding Rites
text:
PRIEST: The Lord be with you.
PEOPLE: And with your spirit.

PRIEST: Go forth, the Mass is ended.
or Go and announce the Gospel of the Lord.
or Go in peace, glorifying the Lord by your life.
or Go in peace.

PEOPLE: Thanks be to God.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Benedicat vos omnipotens Deus, Pater, et Filius, et Spiritus Sanctus. / Amen. / Ite, missa est. / Deo gratias.
